added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_ability_windrunner_tailwind_Note0
added.value: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_ability_windrunner_tailwind_Note1
added.value: Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_ability_vengefulspirit_retribution_Note0
added.value: When attacking units with Pip Health, Vengeful Spirit is considered a ranged attacker.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_ability_sandking_burrowstrike_scepter_description
added.value: Increases Cast Range. Sand King leaves behind a trail of spines, that, after a %spine_duration%s delay, create Stinger attack areas along the path, that apply %spine_damage_pct%%% of Stinger damage to enemies hit.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_phantom_assassin_blurred_Description
added.value: Hidden from enemies. Counts down while an enemy is nearby, and Blur ends when it runs out.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_ability_zuus_cloud_Note3
added.value: The Nimbus has fragile pips: melee heroes and Roshan remove 2 pips per attack.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_ability_dazzle_innate_weave_Note0
added.value: Break disables the applying of new stacks.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_ability_dazzle_innate_weave_Note1
added.value: Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_ability_dazzle_through_the_realm_Description
added.value:
Only active during Nothl Projection. Dazzle pulls his body through the Nothl Realm to his spirit. Nothl Projection ends upon return.

Cannot be cast if Dazzle's body is rooted or leashed.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_ability_rattletrap_armor_power_Note0
added.value: Exact Armor Power bonus is 0.55845%.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_ability_beastmaster_summon_thunderhide_Description
added.value: Beastmaster calls forth an Ancient Thunderhide to fight alongside him. The Thunderhide can Slam the ground to damage and slow nearby enemies, and beats its Thunderhide Drum as Beastmaster or Beastmaster's units attack, increasing their damage and max health.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_ability_beastmaster_summon_thunderhide_Note0
added.value: A newly summoned Thunderhide's Slam starts on a %thunderhide_slam_spawn_cooldown% second cooldown.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_ability_beastmaster_thunderhide_drum_Description
added.value: Attacks from the Ancient Thunderhide, its owner, or a nearby unit its owner controls cause it to beat its drum, building up to %max_stacks% stacks. Each stack increases the max health and base damage of Ancient Thunderhide, its owner, and their other nearby controlled units by %bonus_pct_per_stack%%%. If no attacks are made, stacks are gradually lost. When the Thunderhide dies, or a unit leaves its range, that unit's bonus fades at the same rate.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_beastmaster_thunderhide_drum_Description
added.value: Nearby unit controlled by its owner have increased max health and base damage.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_beastmaster_thunderhide_drum_aura_Description
added.value: Max health increased by %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_EXTRA_HEALTH_PERCENTAGE%%% and base damage increased by %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_BASEDAMAGEOUTGOING_PERCENTAGE%%%. Slowly fades after leaving the Thunderhide's range or when the Thunderhide dies.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_ability_venomancer_plague_ward_Note0
added.value: Poison Sting from a plague ward fully stacks with Poison Sting from Venomancer.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_venomancer_noxious_plague_contagious_Description
added.value: When this debuff ends for any reason, the plague and any other debuffs from Venomancer will spread to nearby allies.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_ability_death_prophet_carrion_swarm_shard_description
added.value: Crypt Swarm has %AbilityCharges% charges with a %AbilityCooldown%s cooldown between uses. Crypt Swarm slows enemies by %slow_movement_pct%%% for %slow_duration%s.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_ability_death_prophet_spirit_siphon_scepter_description
added.value: Spirit Siphon steals %attack_slow% attack speed from each afflicted enemy hero. Spirit Siphon drains an additional %max_health_damage_pct%%% of the target's maximum health per second.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_ability_death_prophet_spirit_siphon_Note1
added.value: Death Prophet's Heal amount is not affected if the damage is mitigated or amplified.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_ability_pugna_oblivion_savant_scepter_description
added.value: Gains %AbilityCharges% charges with a %AbilityChargeRestoreTime% restore time. Pugna can cast any of his abilities an additional time, consuming an Oblivion Savant charge instead.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_ability_templar_assassin_psionic_trap_Note3
added.value: Traps have fragile pips: melee heroes and Roshan remove 2 pips per attack.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_ability_clinkz_infernal_shred_Note0
added.value: Break disables the applying of new stacks.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_ability_clinkz_infernal_shred_Note1
added.value: Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_ability_omniknight_hammer_of_purity_Note0
added.value: When attacking non-hero targets, amount healed is decreased by the standard creep lifesteal factor.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_ability_weaver_time_lapse_ally_Description
added.value: Weaver warps an allied Hero backward to whatever position it was in five seconds earlier - restoring the HP and mana it had at that time. Shares a cooldown with Time Lapse.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_ability_weaver_time_lapse_ally_Lore
added.value: If Skitskurr does not deem the current reality of the world to fit his desires, he simply crawls back in time to right what was wronged.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_ability_weaver_time_lapse_ally_Note0
added.value: Removes most negative buffs from the target.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_chen_zealot_Note0
added.value: Only 1 Zealot may exist at a time.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_chen_zealot_creep_Description
added.value: Moving %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_MOVESPEED_BONUS_CONSTANT% faster, with %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_BASEDAMAGEOUTGOING_PERCENTAGE%%% bonus base attack damage and %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_SPELL_AMPLIFY_PERCENTAGE%%% spell amplification.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_ability_chen_anoint_Description
added.value: Make this creep Chen's Anointed Zealot. After dying it can be respawned next to Chen by activating Zealot, and the previous Anointed becomes a regular controlled creep.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_ability_ancient_apparition_chilling_touch_2_Description
added.value: CHANNELED - Channels a frigid tether, dealing magical damage and slowing the target over time.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_ability_ancient_apparition_chilling_touch_2_scepter_description
added.value: No longer requires a target. Tethers every enemy within cast range and pierces Debuff Immunity. Each tether breaks independently.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_ancient_apparition_chilling_touch_2_Description
added.value: Taking %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_TOOLTIP% magical damage per second and movement speed slowed by %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_MOVESPEED_BONUS_PERCENTAGE%%%.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_ability_gyrocopter_afterburner_Note0
added.value: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_ability_gyrocopter_afterburner_Note1
added.value: Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_ability_spirit_breaker_bull_rush_Note1
added.value: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_ability_spirit_breaker_bull_rush_Note2
added.value: Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_ability_silencer_brain_drain_Note0
added.value: Intelligence Steal is not disabled by Break.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_ability_lycan_feral_impulse_Note0
added.value: Does not increase damage from items.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_ability_lycan_pack_hunter_Description
added.value: Lycan and units under his control mark units on attack for %mark_duration% seconds. When Lycan or a unit under his control attacks a marked unit, it deals bonus damage equal to %bonus_damage%%% of its attack damage per stack, and heals the attacker for %lifesteal%%% of its attack damage per stack.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_ability_lycan_pack_hunter_Note0
added.value: Each unit can apply 1 mark per enemy.

added.value: Marked units are revealed through fog of war and invisibility.

His spirit is stored with the Spirit Bear until the druid is summoned with an active cast of this ability. Killing the Spirit Bear while it keeps Lone Druid's spirit will kill the druid as well.

Passively increases the Spirit Bear's attack leash range by %bonus_attack_leash_range%.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_ability_chaos_knight_armageddon_Description
added.value:
For each second Chaos Knight keeps moving without stopping or attacking, Armageddon gains bonus movement speed. The bonus drains away while stopping, and lost when attacking.

While at least one of Chaos Knight's phantasms is alive, Ahead, Armageddon can be activated to charge over terrain, building up to a max speed before releasing. Chaos Knight and the illusions will attack units they charge over.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_ability_chaos_knight_armageddon_Note0
added.value: Being stunned, hexed, feared, taunted or rooted during the windup cancels the charge.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_ability_chaos_knight_armageddon_Note1
added.value: Ahead, Armageddon is only available when at least 1 of Chaos Knight's illusions created with the active cast of Phantasm is alive.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_ability_chaos_knight_armageddon_Note2
added.value: Activation of Ahead, Armageddon will gather all of Chaos Knight's illusions in %illusion_radius% radius regardless of how they were created.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_chaos_knight_armageddon_charge_Description
added.value: Charging forward with his illusions in formation.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_chaos_knight_armageddons_flank_Description
added.value:
Chaos Knight cracks the reins, causing Armageddon to sprint forward with increasing speed but decreased ability to turn and stop, and turning causes him to slow down. Chaos Knight can use any of his abilities and attack enemies while moving.

Armageddon's Flank cannot be used for %damage_cooldown% seconds after taking damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.

Can be stopped with the sub-ability.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_ability_meepo_divided_we_stand_shard_description
added.value:
Divided We Stand can be cast to pick up the target friendly Meepo or creep, disarming Meepo and disabling them. Use the sub-ability to throw the carried unit at the target, dealing damage and slowing enemies within %radius_tooltip% radius of the impact.

If the carried target is a Meepo, it shares damage with the carrier. The carried target will be dropped if not thrown in time.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_ability_meepo_fling_release_description
added.value:
Throws the Meepo or creep carried by Divided We Stand at the target, dealing damage in a %impact_radius% radius and slowing on impact.

If the carried target is a Meepo, it shares damage with the carrier. The carried target will be dropped after %hold_duration% seconds.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_ability_undying_bite_Description
added.value:
Undying sinks his teeth into his target, dealing his attack damage plus bonus physical damage and healing himself for the amount dealt.

Biting a hero turns them into a zombie for %zombie_duration%s: becoming melee, silenced, %zombie_slow%%% slowed, and dealing %zombie_damage_reduction%%% less damage. Bitten creeps die and become a controllable zombie for %creep_zombie_duration%s.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_undying_bite_zombie_Description
added.value: Turned into a zombie. Melee, silenced, slowed by %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_MOVESPEED_BONUS_PERCENTAGE%%%, and dealing %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_TOTALDAMAGEOUTGOING_PERCENTAGE%%% less damage.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_ability_nyx_assassin_mana_burn_Description
added.value: Deals damage to the target based on its max mana.  A percentage of that damage is dealt as mana burn.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_ability_nyx_assassin_scarab_metabolism_Description
added.value: After %out_of_combat_time%s without taking damage, Nyx Assassin gains bonus movement speed and regenerates based on his max health and max mana per second.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_nyx_assassin_scarab_metabolism_Description
added.value: Regenerating %fMODIFIER_PROPERTY_HEALTH_REGEN_PERCENTAGE%%% max health and %fMODIFIER_PROPERTY_MANA_REGEN_TOTAL_PERCENTAGE%%% max mana per second, and moving %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_MOVESPEED_BONUS_CONSTANT% faster.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_skywrath_mage_arcane_bolt_Description
added.value: Every %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_TOOLTIP% casts of Arcane Bolt launches an additional bolt.

added.value:
Mist Coil affects all units in a %effect_radius% radius around the target.

When Mist Coil hits enemies, Abaddon deals %damage_percentage_on_perform_attack%%% of his attack damage and applies on-hit effects with %potency%%% Item Potency.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_item_caduceus_Description
added.value:
Active: Force

Pushes any target unit %push_length% units in the direction it is facing, and applies one instance of Empower Spell to them.\n

Passive: Empower Spell

The next Unit Target spell you cast on an enemy deals a separate %bonus_spell_damage% bonus damage to the target and slows them by %slow%%% for %slow_duration%s.

The next Unit Target spell you cast on an ally heals them for %bonus_heal% and increases their movement speed by %haste%%% for %haste_duration%s.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_item_caduceus_Note0
added.value: The enemy and ally halves of Empower Spell run on separate cooldowns of %enemy_proc_cooldown%s and %ally_proc_cooldown%s.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_item_caduceus_Note1
added.value: Force applies Empower Spell to its target whether or not that half's cooldown is ready, and does not put it on cooldown.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_item_caduceus_Note2
added.value: Force doesn't interrupt the target's actions.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_item_caduceus_Note3
added.value: Force has %enemy_cast_range% cast range when cast on enemies.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_item_caduceus_enemy_cooldown_Description
added.value: Empower Spell cannot affect enemies until this expires.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_item_caduceus_ally_cooldown_Description
added.value: Empower Spell cannot affect allies until this expires.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_berserkers_sabatons_Description
added.value:
Toggle: Mordiggian's Oath

While active, grants +%unholy_bonus_damage% damage, +%unholy_bonus_strength% Strength, and +%unholy_bonus_armor% armor, and lets you move through units and turn more quickly with %phase_movement_speed%%% increased movement speed on melee heroes and %phase_movement_speed_range%%% on ranged heroes. Also grants up to %unholy_bonus_slow_resistance%%% slow resistance, scaling down with your current health percentage. Drains %unholy_health_drain_per_second% health per second.\n\nYou cannot die from the health drain, nor from the strength loss when deactivated. Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_item_berserkers_sabatons_active_Description
added.value:
Damage increased by %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_PREATTACK_BONUS_DAMAGE%.
Strength increased by %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_STATS_STRENGTH_BONUS%.
Armor increased by %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_PHYSICAL_ARMOR_BONUS%.
Slow resistance increased by %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_SLOW_RESISTANCE_STACKING%%%.
Movement speed increased by %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_MOVESPEED_BONUS_PERCENTAGE%%% and allows you to move through units.
Losing %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_TOOLTIP% health per second.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_item_bloodslinger_Description
added.value:
Active: Sling Grenade

Launch a grenade at the target area. Enemies in the area will take %impact_damage% damage on impact, and be slowed by %movespeed_slow_max%%% and take %damage_over_time% damage every %tick_rate%s for %debuff_duration%s. Movement slow decreases over time to %movespeed_slow_min%%%. Radius %radius%.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_item_bloodslinger_Note0
added.value: Shares a cooldown with Blood Grenade.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_item_bloodslinger_debuff_Description
added.value: Slowed by %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_MOVESPEED_BONUS_PERCENTAGE%%%, taking damage over time.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_roshans_banner_Note0
added.value: The banner has fragile pips: melee heroes and Roshan remove 2 pips per attack.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_stone_of_recall_Description
added.value:
Use: Place Stone

Plants a Stone of Recall at the target location, active the moment it lands. Allied heroes anywhere on the map can channel on the stone to teleport to it.

The stone lasts %duration% seconds. It is immune to spells and has %hits_to_kill% pip health. Creeps and illusions deal 25% damage to it.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_stone_of_recall_Lore
added.value: A shard chipped from one of the ancient waystones, still remembering the road home.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_horn_of_battle_Description
added.value:
Use: Call to Arms

Target an allied barracks anywhere on the map to summon a wave of mega creeps, including a catapult and a flagbearer, in that lane for your team. Can be used from the backpack.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_horn_of_battle_greater_Description
added.value:
Use: Grand Call to Arms

Summons a wave of mega creeps, including a catapult and a flagbearer, in every lane for your team. Can be used from the backpack.

added.value: Chain Lightning does not trigger off of attacks from illusions.

added.value:
Active: Disarm

Prevents a target from attacking for %disarm_duration% seconds.\n\n

Passive: Riposte

Whenever you are within %close_radius% range of an enemy hero, Disarm gains %buff_cooldown_acceleration_pct%%% cooldown acceleration.

added.value: Nearby illusions and nearby heroes in fog of war will activate Riposte.

added.value: Nearby invisible heroes will not activate Riposte.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_modifier_item_skypiercer_Description

Grants %lifesteal_aura%%% lifesteal, %spell_lifesteal_aura%%% spell lifesteal, %damage_aura%%% bonus damage, %mana_regen_aura% mana regeneration, and %armor_aura% armor to nearby allies.

Radius: %aura_radius%

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_ristuls_devotion_Note0
added.value: Lifesteal on attacks against creeps is reduced to %lifesteal_creeps_tooltip%%%.

added.value: Gaining %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_TOOLTIP%%% lifesteal, %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_MAGICAL_LIFESTEAL%%% spell lifesteal, %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_BASEDAMAGEOUTGOING_PERCENTAGE%%% damage, %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_PHYSICAL_ARMOR_BONUS% armor, and %fMODIFIER_PROPERTY_MANA_REGEN_CONSTANT% mana regen.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_starforge_Description
added.value:
Active: Meteor Hammer

CHANNELED - After a %max_duration%s channel, summons a meteor after %land_time%s that strikes a %impact_radius% AoE, stunning enemies for %stun_duration%s and dealing %impact_damage_units% impact damage. Continues to deal %burn_dps_units% damage per second for %burn_duration%s.

Non-building units take an additional %impact_damage_units_pct_health%%% max health impact damage and are slowed by %burn_slow%%% for %burn_duration%s.

Deals %building_damage_pct%%% damage to buildings.\n\n

Passive: Celestial Flare

After any of your disables ends on an enemy unit, they burn for %burn_per_second% damage a second and move %slow_pct%%% slower for %passive_debuff_duration%s.
Celestial Flare can trigger from any of your abilities or items.
Celestial Flare stacks with Meteor Hammer's Burn.

added.name: DOTA_Tooltip_ability_item_starforge_Note0
added.value: Celestial Flare triggers from the following disables: Stun, Hex, Hypnosis, Cyclone, Taunt, Fear, Sleep, and Banish.

added.value: Burning for %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_TOOLTIP% damage every second. Slowed by %dMODIFIER_PROPERTY_MOVESPEED_BONUS_PERCENTAGE%%%.
